name: Ryuko Yone

description:
The blade that cuts through life fibers has arrived in Runeterra. This custom **Ryuko Yone** skin transforms the Unforgotten into the determined student warrior, ready to slice through any opposition. With her signature Scissor Blade in hand, you'll feel the raw power of **Ryuko Matoi**'s combat style as you dash through enemies and unleash the fury of a full-powered life-fiber synch.
